title: Benefits Navigator question spec
description: Contract for a pilot-agnostic interview question set. The traversal engine consumes one such document.

title.description: Human-readable name for this question set.

id.description: Snake_case identifier, unique across the questions array.

prompt.description: The question as shown on screen, one short sentence in plain language.

help.description: Plain-language help text shown under the question.

terms.description: Glossary term IDs shown as links on this screen.

pii.description: True when the field is personally identifiable and must never leave the server (BN-03).

required.description: Whether the flow can advance without an answer. Unknown and unverified answers still satisfy required.

value.description: Snake_case choice value stored as the answer and referenced by skip conditions. Two-letter uppercase codes (e.g. state abbreviations) are also allowed.

label.description: Plain-language choice text shown on screen.

options.description: Allowed choices for single_select and multi_select questions. Required for those types, forbidden for all others.

skip_conditions.description: Skip when any one condition matches (OR across entries).

provenance.description: Where the answer comes from. Constant in this skeleton.

question_id.description: The id of an earlier question whose answer this condition reads.

operator.description: equals/not_equals compare exactly; in/not_in take a comma-separated list; gt is numeric.

value.description: The value to compare against. A comma-separated list for in/not_in.
